full_page.content:
c. 1946
The following is a faithful transcription of an original message hand written by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap., on the margin of a photograph.
c. 1946
To my dear Brother PATRICK CASEY,
Thank God for HOPE. The soul of our happiness here. Hence: "The fool sayeth in his heart: 'There is no God. '" Hle refuses to be happy - in refusing to hope. And the very idea of God and of eternity with Him, as inspired by faith, hope, charity, is the fountain of supernatural confidence, of hope, of happiness.
If we be friends we'll pray for one another's conver- sion - while we breathe.
Purpose of the Rational Creature
God made me to know Him. O what a bles'd aim! To love Him and serve Him Sure rests in the same.
It's leaven-begun for The grateful on Earth - To treasure aright ?!!! Highest Ileaven its worth.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.C.
